_comment_about_this_file: Hand-editable BLB Stage-2 action JSON template (sparse 'base + overrides' form).
Start from the all-max RL baseline, then tweak individual slots in 'overrides'.
kind: F=fresh, W=weight encode, M=mask, S=scalar, R=rescale, K=trunc
F/W/M/S: integer scaling_factor in slot's level_values (see blb_stage2_best_action_full.json)
R: integer scaling_factor or null/'off' (rescale disabled)
L0.B1.K is active; its Gaussian SF/noise chain remains disabled while truncation uses the shared Block 1 runtime.
label: manual_template

overrides._help: Example: tighten layer-3 block-3 truncation to 11 bits.
overrides.label: L3.B3.K
